title: Cochlear
event: ENT Congress: Durban International Convention Centre (Durban ICC)
body: The Cochlear implant is a life-changing product, which helps people to hear, and be heard. Whilst this product’s reputation precedes it, the brand awareness and product demonstrations to the healthcare professionals that attend the ENT Congress is invaluable to Cochlear. The stand was designed with a core focus on product display, with two beautiful custom display podiums for the client to showcase their product in. A second priority on the stand was the graphics of the real life patients whom have had their lives changed by the Cochlear Implant. Large Format Digital Printing allowed for these images to be larger than life on the stand. Lastly, the exhibition stand was designed to be inviting, and encourage both formal and informal discussions with the healthcare professionals in attendance at the congress.

title: Dosco Precision Hydraulics
event: BAUMA Africa: The Johannesburg Expo Centre (Nasrec)
body: BAUMA Africa is an international trade fair for construction machinery, Building Material Machines, Mining Machines and Construction Vehicles. Dosco specialize in the re-manufacturing and supplying of complete hydraulic pumps and motors. Their major focus for the exhibition was to display the range of products in their line. In addition to this, Dosco wanted to increase brand awareness and network with new and existing clients at the show. The stand was designed with the product as it’s core focus, well lit, and structurally stable in order to display the extremely heavy pumps, the stand was inviting and created valuable leads for the client.

title: Fairtrade Tourism
event: World Travel Market (WTM): Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC) · Tourism Indaba: Durban International Convention Centre (DBN ICC)
body: WTM Africa and Tourism Indaba are Africa’s premier exhibitions within the travel sector. Located within Cape Town and Durban respectively, Fair Trade Tourism exhibits at both expos’ in order to increase their brand awareness and connect with new and existing clients. The stand is used as a networking hub for companies that fall underneath the Fair Trade umbrella and practice fair and responsible business in tourism. The exhibition stand was therefore designed to be used at both shows in order to be as cost effective as possible, as well as enhance the brand awareness of Fair Trade Tourism and their clients on the stand.

title: Hägglunds
body: BAUMA Africa is an international trade fair for construction machinery, Building Material Machines, Mining Machines and Construction Vehicles. Hägglunds, develop tough and reliable large hydraulic system solutions. Their main objective for the stand was to create strong brand awareness, and the design therefore incorporated High towers with branding on them, as well as a larger than life CNC cut product replica, in order to visually create the link between the product and the brand. The product was placed front and center of the stand design in order to draw attention to the working demo. Several informal meeting areas and a coffee station were incorporated into the design in order to facilitate meetings with new and existing clients on site.

title: MMS Mobile Cranes
body: BAUMA Africa is an international trade fair for construction machinery, Building Material Machines, Mining Machines and Construction Vehicles. MMS Mobile Cranes has a proven track record and decades of experience on the mobile crane market in Africa and take pride in superior customer service while ensuring their customers have maximum uptime and speedy supply of technical service and original spare parts for all Terex® Mobile Cranes. The client wanted an effective, no fuss, no stress solution for their outdoor stand. The Container was therefore hired out for this project – operated by hydraulics, the container locks up every evening with the push of a button. In order to maximize on the floor space available, a Bedouin tent with laminate wooden flooring was added to the design to be used as an entertainment area on the stand. The addition of custom towers increased the brand visibility of the stand, making them one of the most popular stands on this outdoor terrace.

extra.title: Container for Hire
extra.body: Edge hires out this container on a show-by-show basis. Including all Audio Visual, furniture and graphics as per these visuals. The Container is operated by hydraulics, so the sides of the container lift up with the push of a button. This means at night you can lock up your stand securely and easily, and not have to worry about the safety of the products inside of the container.
features: Operated via hydraulics, lock up and go solution

title: My Bet
body: The Big Africa Summit is a travelling exhibition that is the gateway to the African Gaming Market. My Bet has a global footprint for online betting, and attending the exhibition was therefore important in order to gain momentum within the African Market. As My Bet’s head office is based abroad, they wanted to partner with a local stand designer and workshop, not only to rely on in building their display booth to the standard to which they are accustomed to, but also to handle all the local logistics of delivering their product and marketing collateral to site. In addition to this the Audio Visual (AV) and IT Elements of the project were extremely technical with all the computers and AV needing to be networked, as well as live streaming of different streams to each AV screen. All these technical aspects were sourced and handled locally. The design of the exhibition stand was based off of the My Bet international Corporate Identity, with an African flair. The stand design was open and welcoming.
features: Live streaming and networking of AV and PC’s

title: Nutec
body: FESPA Africa is the region’s largest, focused exhibition for the wide format digital printing, screen printing, garment decoration and textile printing, which is colocated with Sign Africa and Africa Print the region’s leading events for the signage industry. NUtec Digital Ink develops and produces premium quality pigmented Eco, Mild Solvent and UV curable Ink for the high resolution, wide and super wide inkjet digital printing industry. Their goal for the exhibition was to touch base with existing clients; make contact with new potential clients and increase brand and product awareness. Reusing elements of their 2014 FESPA stand; the display stand was re-designed to give the stand a fresh new look for the 2015 show. Rigged bulkheads created maximum brand visibility throughout the exhibition hall, and the stand incorporated a balanced amount of space for meeting areas, casual seating, catering and product displays.

title: Russell Athletic
event: Custom Shopfitting: Retail outlet in a local gym
body: Russell Athletic offers an assortment of high performance athletic wear for Men, Women and Youth. They asked Edge to design and space plan their retail outlet in a local gym. The design had to fit into the look and feel of the gym, whilst still communicate the Russell Athletic Corporate Identity.

In addition to this, maximum display, branding and storage opportunities needed to be made available in the limited space. The design utilized a white backed Vinyl on the windows in order to maximize the branding without darkening the space, pine varnished counter tops, and duco spray finishes.

title: Uniresins
event: Coatings for Africa is an exhibition, which focuses on Africa’s paint and coatings industry.
body: Uniresins participated in this exhibition in order to showcase their range of resins and coatings to industry specialists. With a strong foothold in the market, Uniresins’ focus for the expo was to touch base with existing clients, as well as make contact with new potential clients. They therefore briefed Edge to design an inviting, eye catching display stand. As the stand was an Island stand with 4 open sides, we incorporated the use of a revolving fascia with their logo on the top of the tower in order to enhance the brand visibility. Height was incorporated within the design in order to attract attention to the stand, and storeroom was included within the central tower in order maximize the use of space. The stand had both a formal and informal seating area, in order to allow for casual meetings, and more formal sit down’s. Finally in order to maximize the Return on Investment, the stand was fitted into the Uniresins offices after the show, to create a showroom for Uniresins to use for years to come.

title: Bonitas
body: The Bonitas Comrades Marathon Expo is the largest running-related exhibition in South Africa. As the headline sponsor of the Comrades Marathon, and a fulltime advocate of healthy lifestyle, Bonitas thought it only right to support the greatest of all physical challenges. Their stands at the show were therefore focused on the health and well being of the runners and those that attended the exhibition. 16 Nurses were available on the Main Stand to test the blood pressure and BMI of the public, and the Physiotherapy stand had 11 Physiotherapists on site, giving the runners a pre-race check up, stretch and massage. Edge designed the stand with this space planning in mind.
